sn45.146-148:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānam pabhā || sabbā tā candimāpabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ || candappabhā tāsam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave || la-pe || || Seyyathāpi
sn45.146-148:2.1: bhikkhave saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabham abbhussukkamāno sabbam ākāsagatam tamagatam abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca || evam eva kho bhikkhave || la-pe || || Seyyathāpi
sn45.146-148:3.1: bhikkhave yāni kānici tantāvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ || kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā || appamādo tesam dhammānam aggam akkhāyati || Appamattassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkham ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissatī ti || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāga- nirodha- nissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitam nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkarotī ti || || Appamādavaggo pañcamo || || Sabbam eva sāvatthinidānaṃ || || Tassa uddānaṃ || || Tathāgatam Padaṃ Kūṭam || Mūlaṃ Sāro ca Vassikaṃ || Rājā Candima-Suriyā ca || Vatthena dasamam padaṃ || || Yad api Tathāgataṃ tad api vitthāretabbaṃ || || Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || Seyyathāpi
